label: PORTFOLIO / LAB
content:
name: validate

on:
  push:
    branches: [main, "cursor/**"]
  pull_request:

jobs:
  paths-and-plan:
    name: required files + JML plan
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Required hire-facing paths
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          for f in \
            README.md \
            LICENSE \
            docs/README.md \
            docs/break-glass.md \
            docs/conditional-access.md \
            docs/pim-user-administrator.md \
            docs/group-based-access.md \
            docs/m365-admin-scenarios.md \
            docs/interview-talk-track.md \
            scripts/README.md \
            scripts/config.example.json \
            scripts/common/LabIdentity.psm1 \
            scripts/Invoke-LabJmlDemo.ps1 \
            scripts/joiner/New-LabJoiner.ps1 \
            scripts/joiner/README.md \
            scripts/mover/Set-LabMover.ps1 \
            scripts/mover/README.md \
            scripts/leaver/Invoke-LabLeaver.ps1 \
            scripts/leaver/README.md
          do
            test -f "$f" || { echo "missing $f"; exit 1; }
          done
          echo "All required paths present."

      - name: Lab-only disclaimer in README
        shell: bash
        run: |
          grep -q "LAB ONLY" README.md
          grep -q "supbrice.github.io/portfolio" README.md
          grep -q "customer tenant" README.md
          grep -q "employer tenant" README.md

      - name: JML plan against example config
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
          $ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
          ./scripts/Invoke-LabJmlDemo.ps1 -ConfigPath ./scripts/config.example.json
